When does your shift start tomorrow?

Listen to an announcement in a classroom.

Next Thursday, each of you will display a research poster in the main hall. Visitors from other departments will walk around and ask you about your methods. Your poster must fit on a single board, so do not print anything larger than one meter wide. Your final grade for the poster will come from me, based on the rubric I posted online.
Listen to an announcement in a classroom.

For our museum field trip on Saturday, you'll spend the morning sketching three objects from the ancient pottery collection. After lunch, the museum's curator will hold a workshop on how archaeologists restore broken pottery. By the following Friday, please hand in a two-page reflection that compares two of the objects you sketched.

t7-ride.title: TPO7 Transfer — ride to the concert

lines.t: Are you still going to the concert downtown on Sunday?
I'd love to, but my car is in the repair shop until next week, and the buses don't run late on Sundays.
I can drive you. I'm going anyway.
Really? That would be great. I was worried I'd have to miss it.

options: It was a long day yesterday.
why: 일 이야기이긴 하지만 지금 끝낼지에 대한 답이 아님
시작 시각이 아니라 끝나는 시각을 말함
걸리는 시간을 말함 — 묻는 시간의 종류가 다름

options: It left about ten minutes ago.
I'll take a taxi next time.

next time은 다음 이야기 — 질문은 지금 상황을 물음

options: The lab is on the third floor.

options: Friday works better for me too.

qs.prompt: What can be inferred about the posters?
options: They will be graded by visitors.
They must be finished by Monday.
why: ✗ visitors는 질문만 함. 채점은 강사가 함(from me)
qs.evidence: do not print anything larger than one meter wide

qs.prompt: What must students submit by the following Friday?
options: A written comparison of two objects
why: ✓ two-page reflection that compares two of the objects
qs.evidence: please hand in a two-page reflection that compares two of the objects you sketched

qs.prompt: What will the afternoon workshop be about?
why: ✓ restore broken pottery ≈ repairing damaged pottery
qs.evidence: the museum's curator will hold a workshop on how archaeologists restore broken pottery

qs.prompt: Why was the woman worried she might miss the concert?
options: She had to work on Sunday.
She didn't have a way to get there.
She didn't know where it was.
why: ✗ 일정 문제는 나오지 않음 — 흔한 이유를 지어낸 것
✓ 차는 수리 중이고 버스도 없어서 갈 방법이 없음
qs.evidence: my car is in the repair shop until next week, and the buses don't run late on Sundays

items.passage: Early maps showed coastlines as fixed lines, yet geologists now know that shores are remarkably fluid, shifting with every storm and season.

qs.prompt: The word "fluid" in the passage is closest in meaning to
why: ✓ fixed와 대비되는 fluid, 그리고 shifting이 단서
qs.evidence: coastlines as fixed lines, yet geologists now know that shores are remarkably fluid, shifting with every storm and season
